principle_violations.reason: The UserService directly depends on the concrete implementation of MySQLDatabase. This violates the Dependency Inversion Principle since the high-level class UserService is directly dependent on a low-level class.
principle_violations.suggestion: Instead of depending on concrete implementations, the high-level class UserService should depend on abstractions. Create a Database interface as an abstraction.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details below.
